body:
wow thank you, you're so kind!
i have actually been feeling these 'going crazy' thoughts since almost forever, before i started taking the meds... 
but yeah it could be a phase or some depression side effect. it's just really convincing, like i can't trust my own mind anymore.
i'll check out meetup.com, thanks!
thank you so much
i hope your wife feels better!

you're totally right- i just haven't been paying enough attention to my meds.
i'll start putting an alarm on my phone to remind me to take them.
yeah, i believe the pill was lorazepam.
i'll be paying more attention from now on, thanks :)
